parameters.prompt:
=You are an elite legal writer for common-law.ai.

Write a complete, authoritative legal article based on this outline:
{{ $json.message?.content || $json.text }}

Topic: "{{ $('Select Approved Topic').item.json.title_idea }}"
Keyword: "{{ $('Select Approved Topic').item.json.primary_keyword }}"
Jurisdiction: {{ $('Select Approved Topic').item.json.target_state }}
Practice Area: {{ $('Select Approved Topic').item.json.practice_area }}

MANDATORY LEGAL ACCURACY & CITATION RULES:
1. ONLY cite URLs from verified primary legal domains: law.cornell.edu, justia.com, courtlistener.com, federalregister.gov, uscourts.gov, congress.gov
2. Mark any claim you cannot definitively source with: [UNVERIFIED — NEEDS REVIEW]
3. NEVER invent case names, docket numbers, or statute section numbers
4. Include every source you cited in the sources[] array

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "article_html": "Full HTML article using h2/h3/p/ul/ol/strong tags. Do NOT include an h1 tag.",
  "sources": [{"title": "Official authority title", "url": "https://...", "cited_for": "rule of law"}],
  "unverified_claims": ["Any claim marked as unverified"]
}
